description: This file contains extension methods for the interface IStreamSubscriptionManager, providing various overloads of AddSubscription for different grain key types, as well as a helper method for retrieving the subscription manager from a stream provider.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManagerExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IStreamSubscriptionManager related to adding subscriptions for various grain key types and retrieving associated subscription managers.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, GrainId)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a GrainId (Guid key) to the specified stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, Guid, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a Guid primary key to the specified stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, long, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a long (integer) primary key to the specified stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, string, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a string primary key to the specified stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, Guid, string, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a Guid compound key to the specified stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, long, string, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a long compound key to the specified stream.

methods.name: TryGetStreamSubscriptionManager(this IStreamProvider, out IStreamSubscriptionManager)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the IStreamSubscriptionManager from a stream provider, returning true if successful.
